tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sngags kyi spyi don tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgra

zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / oṃ swa sti sing+nghaṃ/ sngags kyi spyi don tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgra zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams byed po ye nas rnam grol rang bzhin bzang*/ /mnyam pa'i bdag nyid kun nas ma bslad mkha' dang mtshungs/ /chos rnams rang bzhin bya ba rnam dag dmigs med dbyings/ /yid chos byed dang bya 'gyur kun bzang yab yum 'dud/ /chos sku'i mkha' la gzugs sku rnam dag rol ba'i sprin/ /theg mchog gsang ngag sku dang rab ldan 'brug glog zab/ /gdul bya gang 'dul khro chags rnam grol char gyi rgyun/ /rgyud rab rlan byed zhi khro'i tshogs la dang bas 'dud/ /don gyi snying po gsang sngags rdo rje theg /tshig don rnam bkra gsal bar nges bya'i phyir/ /rgyal dgongs ma 'khrul sngags kyi spyi yi don/ /cung zad bkrol gyi mkhas kun dga' bar mdzod/ /de la 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal kun tu bzang po thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba'i mnga' bdag des/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang chen po nas ma g.yos bzhin tu rang bzhin thugs rje'i byin gyis rlabs kyi rang snang las/ sku gsung thugs lhun grub stug po bkod pa'i rgyan nyid du rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par bzhengs te/ phyogs bzhi dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor nyid las mi gzhan pa'i mnga' thang chen po la dbang bsgyur bas/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa 'bras bu sems dpa' rnams la zab cing rgya che ba'i chos phun sum tshogs pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsungs te/ snang ba gsum gyis 'dul bar bya ba'i khams rang bzhin gyis grol bar mdzad pa las/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan brgyud gsum las/ dang po ni kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid des dbang phyug chen po'i 'og min du 'bras bu byang chub sems dpa' brjod du med pa dang gnyis su med par bzhugs te/

de nyid dang lhan cig pa'i 'khor rnams la zab mo'i dbang gsum bskur bas brjod bya don gyi rgyud rtogs te/ rang don du sangs rgyas so/ /de nas gzhan don du zhu ba {thun mong lam stegs gnyis pa'i snga phul bas ston pa thugs rje skyes te/ gsungs pa zhal gyis bzhes te spro ba gnyis mdzad pa las/ ston pa'i thugs rig pa'i ye shes kyi khyad par las/ thun mong bca' bzhi'i ston pa drug spros te/ thun mong lam stegs kyi theg pa mtha' dag gsungs pa dang*/ ston pas chos tshul 'di nyid 'chad pa'i tshul drug mdzad nas 'og min du gsungs pa nyid gnyis dus mtshungs par bstan pa'i rgyud tha dad par 'byung ba'o/ /de la'ang gsum ste/ gnas/ ston pa/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la'ang bzhi ste/ sgra don/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ rtsod pa spang pa ste/ dang po ni/ a ka niṣ+tha'i sgra las dman par ma gyur pa'am 'og min pa ste gong mar gyur pa'i don to/ /gnyis pa ni/ gnas su gyur pa gang zhig dus gang na chos 'phags pa'i gnas gzhan med pa ste 'og min tsam gyi mtshan nyid do/ / chos sku'i 'og min gyi mtshan nyid ni/ mthar thug gi bgrod bya'i gnas yin pa gang zhigagazugs sku gnyis kyi 'char gzhi'i rten byed pa/ longs sku'i nges pa lnga ldan snang pa'i gnas su gyur pa gang zhig /sprul sku'i 'char gzhi'i rten byed pa/ sprul sku ni gtsang ma'i gnas gang zhig /'jig rten du snang ba'i gnas kyi mchog yin pa'o/ /de yang 'jig rten gyi khams dang zhing khams kyi khyad ni/ sprul skus gdul ba'i zhing dang*/ longs sku dang chos sku'i zhing gi khyad yod do/ / gsum pa dbye ba la gsum ste/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku 'og min no/ /dang po ni/ mtha' dbus phyogs cha gang du'ang bzhag tu med cing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi mthar thug gam bgrod bya dam pa ste yang dag don gyi 'og min zhes bya'o/

/de skad du'ang kun byed las/ ston pa chos sku'i gnas ni 'di lta ste/ /'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang ste/ /yang dag don gyi 'og min de ru bshad/ /ces so/ /longs sku'i 'og min ni chos sku'i dbyings las ye shes chen po'i snang ba rang byung ba 'od kyi gzhal yas khang dang gtso 'khor du snang ba ye shes lnga'i rigs su lhun gyis grub cing dus thams cad du 'pho 'gyur med pa ste/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje las/ gtsang ma'i ris dag spangs pa yi/ /'og min chen po'i gnas mchog ni/ /rigs bdag phyag rgya lhun grub sku/ /gcig dang du ma rnam spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi gzugs te/ / gdod ma'i theg chen mdzod nyid phyir/ /sgrib pa mtha' spangs gdul bya la/ / skad cig gis ni gnang ba mdzod/ /ces so/ /de yang gtsang gnas spangs zhes pa ni de las 'das pa ste/ 'jig rten gyi snang ba las 'phags pa yin gyi de'i ya rol na yod pa'i nges pa med de/ sangs rgyas gang na bzhugs pa'i rang snang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang bzang spyod las/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /zhes pa'i rdul phra rab kyi nang na'ang mi bzhugs zhes mi bsam zhing*/ de na'ang lhun grub stug po bkod pa'i zhing rnam par ma 'gags so/ /de na'ang gnas kyi phyogs blos phyogs char chad pa gcig tu btsal mi dgos te/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i dbang las/ yon tan gyi khyad par gang du snang ba de nyid rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du shes par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i gnas de nyid 'og min chen po zhes bya ste sangs rgyas nyid kyi rol pa las gzhan gyi longs spyod ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ mi bskyod pa rdo rje'i rigs/ rin chen 'byung ldan rin po che'i rigs/ 'od dpag med pad+ma'i rigs/ don yod grub pa las kyi rigs te so so'i dkyil 'khor tshom bu nam mkha' dbyings kyi mthas klas par rang snang lhun gyis grub pa'o/

/de ltar snang ba'i sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba de yang gcig tu ma grub ste sna tshogs su snang zhing*/ du mar ma grub ste longs sku de nyid gcig gi rang snang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i zhing dang sku dang ye shes su snang ba ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang snang longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i spyi gzugs te thams cad kyi spyod yul ma yin la sangs rgyas longs sku rnams spyi mthun pa'i snang ba'o/ /de na snang ba'i gtso 'khor de dag theg pa chen po'i chos thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzod yin te/ sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs sku'i ngang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /da ltar snang ba de yang sgrib pa mtha' dag spangs pa'i tshe skad cig de nyid chos sku dang snga phyi mi phyed par snang ba yin no/ /gdul bya la snang zhes pas sa thob pa'i spyod yul ma yin te/ sgrib pa mtha' dag spangs zhes pa de ma tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /gnas de'i yon tan snang tshul ni/ sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho las/ 'jig rten gnas kyi 'og min las/ /nyis 'gyur du ni dpags pa yin/ /ngo bo mtha' gsum las 'das pa// yon tan lnga yi bdag nyid de/ /ma spangs rgyan rdzogs gzhal yas khang*/ /gru bzhi spyi bo'i 'khyil pa gnas/ /zhes pas/ longs sku'i rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams yin pas na/ gtsang ma'i 'og min dang*/ sar gnas kyi snang ba rang bzhin sprul sku'i 'og min gnyis las snang ba de nyid 'phags so/ /de lta bu'i zhing gi ngo bo yod med rtag chad spros pa'i mtha' gsum las 'das shing*/ sku gsungs thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i yon tan lnga'i rang bzhin can snang ba'i rgyan phul du phyin pas spras pa'i gzhal med khang nam mkha'i dbyings kun tu khyab par snang ba'o/ /de yang gang du dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med par 'dres pa'i gnas de nyid du sangs rgyas longs sku'i snang ba de nyid 'char ba yin te/ dbu ma chos dbyings su bstod pa las/

dbang phyug chen po'i gnas mchog dang*/ /'og min de nyid rnam mdzes pa/ /shes pa gsum pa gcig nyid du/ /'dres par gyur na bdag smra'o/ /zhes so/ /dbang phyug chen po ni longs sku nyid de chos thams cad kyi 'byor ba dam pa la dbang bsgyur pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa sku spyi'i snang ba yin pas snang ba mi 'dra ba tha dad du bzhag pa med kyang*/ rgyal ba so sos byang chub brnyes pa'i longs sku'i zhing cha nas longs sku'i khams so sor phye ba tsam du zad de/ theg bsdus las/ /bdag du 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir/ gnas la tha dad yod ma yin/ /sngon gyi rjes su 'brangs bas kyang*/ /de la dgag pa tha dad 'byed/ /ces so/ /de ltar rang snang longs sku'i zhing du sangs ma rgyas na 'jig rten du sgron ma bkod pa nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad mi nus te/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ yang dag sangs rgyas 'og min du/ /sangs rgyas ma gyur 'dod khams su/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa mi mdzad do/ /zhes so/ /de nyid rgyal ba khams gsum las 'das pas gnas kyang de'i sgras brjod de/ de nyid las/ gzugs med 'dod dang gzugs rnams dang*/ /'du shes med pa de bzhin te/ /gnas las 'das so sangs rgyas dbang*/ /bzhugs so stug po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /zhes sogs gnas der rang snang dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga'i chos phun sum tshogs pa rang bzhin byin gyi rlabs kyis thugs sems dpa' la ston pa kun tu bzang po nyid longs skur snang bas gsungs te/ gsang snying las/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la ched du gleng ngo zhes pa dang*/ gzhan las kyang tshul de dang mthun par gsungs so/ /gsum pa sprul sku'i 'og min la gnyis te/ gdul bya la gnas pa'i don du rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing dang 'dres ma'i don du gtsang ma ris kyi 'og min bstan pa'o/

/dang po ni/ dbus na 'og min khang bu brtsegs pa'i stug po bkod pa/ shar na mngon par dga' ba/ lho na rin po ches brgyan pa/ nub na bde ba can/ byang na las rab grub pa'i zhing lngar 'khor sa bcu'i sems dpa' la/ ston pa rigs lnga'i chos theg pa chen po thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam grangs zhal dang ljags las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse las rang snang zhing*/ me long lta bu'i snang bas sgrib pa sbyang bar 'dod de/ gsang snying las/ 'og min bla med gnas mchog tu/ /sku ni rnam par snang mdzad tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rnams la/ /de bzhin gsung mchog mi smra ste/ /sku yis chos rnams 'jal bar ston/ /me long bstan pa'i tshul bzhin du/ /dngos kyi mdog ngan thams cad sel/ /'khor gyi de bzhin sku bltas na/ /byang chub sgrib pa gting dpag med/ / me long bzhin du sku la snang*/ /de nas sa bcu rim gyis 'byor/ /bla med byang chub yang dag thob/ /ces so/ /dus ni mi zad rgyan gyi 'khaur lo ste rtag par ro/ /khyad par du zhi ba dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor rigs lnga mngon par snang bas rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor chen po'i theg pa gsungs so/ /zhing de yang 'jig rten las 'phags pas steng zhes brjod de/ kun byed las/ ston pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gnas bstan te/ 'jig rten mtshan ma kun gyi steng gyur pa/ /gnas kyi 'og min khang bu brtsegs pa yi/ /gzhal yas khang de gnas kyi 'og min bshad/ /ces so/ /'khor yang sems dpar bshad de/ de nyid las/ ston pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor bstan pa/ /mos spyod bzhi yi sa las 'das pa yi/ /dang po rab tu dga' ba'i sa mnan nas/ sa bcu chos kyi sprin gyi sa pa rnams/ /de ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor du bstan/ /zhes so/ /chos kyang sku dang ye shes kyi dgongs pas ston te/ de nyid las/ ye shes longs spyod 'og min bzhugs pa yi/ /sa bcu pa yi byang chub sems dpa' la/

/byang chub sems de sku dang ye shes bshad/ /ces so/ /ji ltar bshad na de la/ longs spyod rdzogs sku rang gi ngo bos ston/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa 'dres ma'i tshul du gtsang ris kyi 'og min bstan pa ni/ mi mjed la sogs 'gro ba sems can gyi snang ba dang mthun pa'i gnas kyi mchog rang rang gi 'jig rten de'i gzugs kyi khams bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gtsang ma ris kyi lha lnga'i gnas kyi 'og min rags pa'i dngos po ma yin pa/ dang ba 'od kyi rang bzhin las grub pa'i gnas/ gzhal yas khang la sogs pa bkod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pas brgyan pa der/ 'jig rten du sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i tshe sprul pa'i dang po longs sku dang chos mthun pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sangs rgyas su bstan nas/ lha dang grub pa dang rig sngags 'chang gi dbang po tshad med pa la bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la sogs pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa'i theg pa du mas 'dul bar kun tu ston te/ de skad du'ang legs par grub pa'i rgyud las/ gtsang ma'i 'og min rnam mdzes par/ /grub pa dbang po la sogs pa/ /rig sngags gzungs sngags rnal 'byor dang*/ /rgyud chos du mas tshim par mdzad/ /ces so/ /gzhan yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i spyan 'grel las/ don gyi 'og min chos kyi dbyings te sangs rgyas bzhugs gnas yin zhing de'i gong na gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ / rtags kyi 'og min dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med kyi rtags su gzhal yas khang gi dbyibs dang kha dog tu snang ba ste longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bzhugs gnas yin zhing chos kyi dbyings mtshon byed kyi rtags de'i gong na gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /rig pa'i 'og min dngos po'i gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa rig pa'i ye shes te/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos sku'i bzhugs gnas yin zhing de'i gong na rig pa gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/

/gsang ba'i 'og min yum gyi mkha' ste/ gsang ba sku'i bzhugs gnas yin zhing*/ mi gnas yon tan gong na gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /rtogs pa'i 'og min las dang po pas 'og min gyi gzhal yas khang sgom pa ste/ lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi bzhugs gnas yin zhing*/ don spyi 'dzin byed kyi rtog pa de'i gong na gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten gnas kyi 'og min gtsang ma ris kyi lha lnga'i yang steng ste/ 'phags pa rnams kyi bzhugs gnas yin zhing gzugs khams kyi gnas de'i gong na gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i don drug 'byung yang snga ma'i khongs su 'du ste/ don dang rig pa'i 'og min chos skur 'du zhing*/ rtags kyi longs sku gzhan gsum sprul skur 'du sta/ gnas kyi 'og min yin la/ gsang pa dang*/ rtogs pa'i 'og min ni sprul sku'i lam nyams su len pas de'i khongs su 'du'o/ /bzhi pa rtsod pa spang pa ni/ rgyud gsungs pa'i gnas rang snang longs sku'i zhing du gdul bya rang rgyud pa med na chos bstan pa'i dgos pa med cing*/ don rtags kyi dkyil 'khor yang gdul bya la bstan gyi rang gi thugs kyi sprul pa la bstan mi dgos te/ sprul pa la rtog pa med pa'i phyir ro/ de nas rang rgyud pa'i 'khor dang sprul pa gnyis ka'o zhes zer ro/ /de ni khyed kyi dgongs pa ma lon par snang ste/ sprul pa'i gdul bya yod pa'i chos bstan pa'i dgos pa yod de phyi rabs gsang bdag gis 'chad pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir dang*/ don rtags kyi ched du gdul bya la bstan pa ma yin gyi rang snang la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yon tan lhun rdzogs su shar ba ste me long gi ngos la gzugs brnyan snang ba bzhin no/ /sprul pa la rtog pa med kyang ye shes yod pas de nyid kyis chos nyan zhing 'dzin par byed do/ /gal te sprul pa la rig pa'i ye shes med na shākya thub pa dang gsang bdag la sogs pa'i ji lta ba ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes mi mnga' bar thal ba'i skyon yod de/

lung gis kyang gnod de/de bzhin thugs kyi khyad par las/ /rang snang rgyal ba'i sems rdzogs dang*/ /zhes dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la ched du gleng ngo*/ /zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin nyid kyis dbyings nyid dbang bsgyur ye shes dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i ngang*/ /

rang snang ba nyid ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan sgyu ma rnam dag gsal ba ni/ /zhes pa la sogs pas gnod/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum dang rnam par 'phrul pa dang zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab cing tshad med de/ sdong po bkod pa las/ spu yi rtse mo gcig la yang*/ /zhing rnams bye ba bsam mi khyab/ /sna tshogs dbyibs kyang tha dad de/ /de dag 'dres par gyur ba med/ /ces gsungs pas/ nam mkhas gang du khyab par chos sku dang longs skus khyab cing*/ sems can gyis gang du khyab par sprul pa'i sku dang phrin las kyis khyab pas bde bar gshegs pa'i zhing khams la phyogs dang ris su chad pa med/ zhing 'di nyid kyi gong na gzhan dag bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi long pa yod pa rtogs par bya zhing*/ ma dag par snang ba yang rang gi snang ba tsam las dag pa'i zhing du blta bar bya ste/ nyi zla'i snang ba dag pa ma yin mod kyi/ dmus long rnams kyis ma mthong ba bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /rnam par gzhag pa 'di ni shin tu dka' ba'i gnas te gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rig 'dzin brgyud pa yang gnyis las/ rig 'dzin mi ma yin pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa nyid kyi sprul pa rigs gsum du snang bar mdzad de/ lha klu gnod sbyin gsum la brgyud pa yang*/ 'jam dpal mkhyen pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa ni/ gtso bor zab mo'i phyogs kyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa las lta ba'i phyogs ston/ spyan ras gzigs thugs rje'i mnga' bdag tu gyur te/ gtso bor byams snying rjes bskyab pa'i phyogs kyi don mdzad pa sgrub pa'i phyogs ston/ phyag na rdo rje mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur te/ gtso bo thabs mkhas pa'i drag shul phyogs kyi don mdzad pas spyod pa'i phyogs ston/ kha cig re res kyang lta grub spyod pa gsum ka bstan par bzhed de/ de yang 'jam dpal gzhon tshul mdzes pa'i sku dang ldan pas/ lha rnams kyi lus dang bsam pa dang mthun par bstan te lha gnas su grags pa na phyogs skyong la bshad/

des lha tshangs pa rin chen 'od 'bar la/ des tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag /tshangs pa kun grol/ gtsug phud 'dzin/ des lha dbang brgya byin la/ des tshom bu 'bum sde la/ lha rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin zhing sangs rgyas kyi gdung sob par 'gyur ro/ /spyan ras gzigs bdud rtsi sman gyi sku dang ldan pa des/ klu gdug pa can gyi lus dang bsam pa dang mthun par klu rgyal rigs gh+ri na nag po la bstan/ des klu mo ma ma kha 'dul/ des klu mo 'dul tshang ma/ des klu yid 'ong dga'/ des tshom bu 'bum sde la bshad de sngar bzhin du gyur to/ /phyag na rdo rjes 'jigs tshul 'bum bsdigs pa'i sku dang ldan pas gnod sbyin gnas su gnod sbyin gyi lus dang bsam pa dang mthun par gnod sbyin kun tu bzang po la bstan/ des gnod sbyin grags ldan phyogs skyong la/ des gnod sbyin tshom bu 'bum sde la bshad de sngar bzhin du gyur to/ /gnyis pa rig 'dzin mi dang mi ma yin gnyis la brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'das par dgongs nas 'khor bsdus te/ the tshom chod cig par bskul bas 'khor gyi nang nas rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po ku ma dza ra zhes bya ba stan las langs te/ dri ba lnga dris pa'i dang po gsang sngags nam 'byung zhes pa'i lan tu/ spyir byung tshul bcu gnyis kyis the tshom 'byung bar lung bstan pa las/ khyad par lung che nges par bstan pa'i tshul las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis nas/ /lha gnas gsum du grags pa yi/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /'dzam gling shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi/ /mi las skal ldan rigs can te/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /sngon du ltas snang snang gyur pa/ /drags shul can zhes bya ba'i rtser/ /grogs kyi sems can dman pa'i lus/ /lang ka'i bdag po la sogs la/ /lag na rdo rjes gnang bar 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan te mya ngan las 'das so/

/de lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad nas dam pa'i rigs can lnga nang du mnyam par 'jog pa las langs pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi ston pa nub par gyur pas rmag chad par ngus so/ /kun kyang rang rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi bya bas za hor gyi yul khams zhes bya ba'i nye 'khor na/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs kyis bcags pa/ ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse zhes bya ba zhig na/ rtse mo na ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ges 'khrab par gyur pa/ 'dab shod na gcan gzan stag gi phreng ba yod pa/ rtsa ba dang sdong po shun pa pags pa lo ma 'bras bu sman sna tshogs kyi shing skyes pa/ ngos la brag dkar po seng ges khyi tshugs bca' ba 'dra ba yod pa de'i rtse la 'dus te/ shin tu nyam thag pa'i nga ros gdung ba gsum gsum bton pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas gsan nas/ thams cad kyis gsang ba'i bdag po la bskul bas/ gsang ba'i bdag pos rigs can lnga la mngon sum du snang bar mdzad nas lha'i rigs grags ldan phyogs skyong*/ klu 'jog po/ gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong*/ srin po blo gros thabs ldan/ mi las skal ldan dge slong li tsa bī dri ma med par grags pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar dam pa'i rigs can lnga la gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor ro/ /de'i tshe srin po blo gros thabs ldan gyis gsang sngags kyi rgyud rnams tshig dang yi ger bsdus pa'i byin rlabs mi yul du snang ba'o/ / gsum pa gang zag rna bar brgyud pa ni/ de'i byin rlabs kyis za hor gyi yul a par ta mu ta'i skal ldan rgyal po dza zhes bya ba de ri ma la ya'i shar ngos la tri sha a su ra zhes bya ba gnod sbyin gyi phug pa yod de sgo zla gam la ngo mtshar gyi ri mo rang byung ba/ phug na rat+na zur brgyad la nyi zla'i ri mo rang snang ba/ brag de'i spyi bor bya ka lan+ta ka zhes bya ba don gnyis par mi sgrog par byed pa'i tshang bcas pa der gang zag skal ldan gyi bgrod pa las/

de ma yin gyi ma phyin pas gnas khyad par can de na bzhugs pa'i tshe na/ dus der rmis ltas thun mong ma yin pa bdun shar te/ dang po de'i rtse mor dpal phyag na rdo rje byon te/ sku'i khyon las 'od sngon po 'phros pas 'jig rten thams cad bsregs nas mi snang bar byas/ gsung gi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba lta bu thos/ thugs las rdo rje 'bar ba zhig shar nas rgyal po'i thugs kar thim pa rmis/ nyi ma 'od 'bar ba spyi bor thim/ zla ba 'od 'bar ba zhig shar nas rkang mthil du thim nas snang srid thams cad lto ba nas 'phyo ba rmis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chos kyi bgro ba mdzad cing nyi zla la chibs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing*/ srid gsum kha lo gyen du bsgyur ba zhig rmis so/ gsum pa ni/ nam mkha'i 'od las gser gyi snying po can gyi kha dog ni 'thibs/ cho 'phrul 'brug sgra go bar sla zhing snyan pa dang tshim pa ni grags/ rat+na sna tshogs kyi rmug pa ni 'thibs/ rat+na bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od ni lhung*/ snang srid gsal ba'i glog ni 'khyug /rat+na'i char mngon par 'bab pa zhig rmis so/ /bzhi pa ni/ lo ka'i bstan bcos kun gyi 'gyur/ rat+na 'bar ba'i sgron me 'bar bas snang srid kyi mun pa ni bsal/ bdud rtsi sman gyi chu rgyun byung bas 'gro ba thams cad kyi gcong rnying ni sbyangs/ 'gro ba thams cad kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor zhes sgra di ri ri sgrogs pa zhig rmis so/ /lnga pa ni/ sprin gyi nang nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rat+na sna tshogs kyi 'od zer can zhig 'bar ba'i dkyil nas rat+na smug po dpal gyi be'u sgrom 'od dang bcas pa phyi nang thams cad gsal bar snang ba'i nang nas gser gyi glegs bam la bai ḍūr+ya'i zhun mas rgya rang mnan du bris pa'i glegs bam mang po skar mda' thang la lhung ba bzhin 'bab pa zhig rmis so/ /drug pa ni/ glegs bam de dag las byang chub sems dpa' mang po dang*/

rig 'dzin lha dang lha mo tshad med pa'i yon tan sgrog cing mchod bstod skor glog byed pa rmis so/ /bdun pa ni/ nam mkha'i sprin gseb nas lung bstan pa'i sgra byung sta/ las dang skal bar rab ldan zhing*/ rgyal bas 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i/ /bsod nams chen po dra ma khyod/ /sprul par ji ltar lung bstan zhing*/ da lta'i dus 'dir mngon shar gyi/ /'khor bar snying po bya ba'i phyir/ /nga yi cho 'phrul byin rlabs kyis/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig / skal ldan khyod la bstan par bya/ /ma la ya zhes bya ba'i rtser/ /dgon pa chen po'i gnas shig tu/ /ye shes snying po can rnams kyi/ /gsang ba bya ba'i dam pa zhig /yod kyi gsang ba nan tan gyi/ /de la sems kyi me long gis/ /mngon du gsal bar rtogs ma thag /sangs rgyas sa la skal ba mnyam/ /bde ba can zhes bya bar ni/ /'od kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i/ /kun rig bde ba chen por 'gyur//rdo rje gsang chen gsang ba yi/ /dam pa'i mdzod gnyis gcig la ni/ /lha dang mi yi rig 'dzin la/ /rim pas brgyud de grags par 'gyur/ /zhes grags par rmis/ de nas nang par sad de rab tu dgyes nas nyid kyi 'khor rnams bsdus nas/ rmi lam byung ba'i lo rgyus gsungs pa/ mdang gsum bdag la rmi lam 'di ltar byung*/ ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod rtse la/ /phyag na rdo rje'i pho brang gnas bzhugs te/ /sku las 'od 'phros snang srid byi dor byas/ /gsung gi sgra yis lo ka g.yo zhing 'gul/ /thugs las 'od byung bdag gi snying kar thim/ /nyi zla spyi bo rkang pa'i mthul du nub/ /bdag gi lto nas snang srid 'phyo ba rmis/ /dang po'i rmis ltas bag chag byung ba'i rtags/ /de nas bdag la sangs rgyas mang po rnams/ /rmad byung gsang ba'i don la bgro ba mdzad/ /nyi zla pad+ma seng ge khri steng na/ /chos kyi 'khor lo 'gro la bskor zhing rmis/ /gnyis pa yin te chos la dbang thob rtags/

/de nas mkha' la rat+na'i sprin gseb nas/ /snyan pa'i 'brug sgra gsal ba'i glog 'gyu ste/ /rat+na chos kyi char pa 'bab pa rmis/ /rmi lam gsum pa yin te dge ba'i ltas/ /'gro la thugs rje'i chos kyi char 'bebs rtags/ /de nas lo ka rat+nas gang byas te/ /nor bu 'od 'bar 'gro ba'i mun pa bsal/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi chu rgyun 'bab pa yis/ /'gro ba'i nad rnying gtan nas sbyangs byas nas/ /'gro kun rnal 'byor zhes ni grags par 'gyur/ /bzhi pa yin te 'di yang dge ba'i ltas/ /'gro kun rnal 'byor gral du bzhag pa yin/ /drug pa rmi lam glegs bam de dag la/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rig 'dzin mang po'i tshogs/ /yon tan sgra sgrog mchod skor byed pa rmis/ /rmad byung che ba ston pa'i snga ltas yin/ /tha ma nam mkha'i dbyings rum sprin gseb nas/ /cho 'phrul rang sgra bdag lung bstan pa'i tshig /rim gyis gsang ba grags pa'i sgra sgrogs rmis/ /gsang ba dam pa rgya cher sgraug pa'i ltas/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gong gi rmi lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa dag kyang brjod nas/ rmi lam 'di dag dang sbyar na bdag nges par skal ba dang ldan par nges zhes gsungs pa las/ 'khor rnams kyis kyang de ltar legs so a la la zhes ngo mtshar du gsol te/ yang bka' stsal pa/ de ltar yin phan chad pho brang gi rtse mor phyin la cho 'phrul gyis de la dmigs pa bcas te/ mchod pa dang sgrub pa chen po zhig byas na dga' ba chen po zhig skye bar nges pas/ bdag yang thog tu gshegs so gsungs te byon pa las/ rmi lam ji ltar byon pa'i ngos shig la/ rat+na smug po las grub pa'i badz+ra pā ṇi'i sku khru gang ba zhig mthong nas rgyal po dgyes nas phyag dang skor ba byas nas tshigs su brjod pa/ sngon tshe gang nas bsgrub pa yi/ /las kyis mjal ba'i lha mchog ni/ /bskal bar gzhal yang mi gtang ngo*/ /'dren pa mchog dpal la sogs grangs/ /mos pa'i gzungs kyi lha mchog 'dzin/

/zhes gsol nas thugs dam du byas te/ rgyal po yid gongs bas rtags 'di dag dang ldan na/ ri bo 'di dpal phyag na rdo rje'i rang bzhin du nges pa dang*/ rig 'dzin grub pa thob pa'i gnas yin par gtam rnying pa thos pa dang*/ gcan gzan gdug pa can yang dge ba can la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshul dang sbyar na/ 'grub par nges pa 'grub snyam nas sgrub pa gzugs brnyan de la brten nas zla ba bdun pa'i rmi lam mthun pa'i glegs bam de dag la rab tu dga' ba'i tshul gyis gsung gi sgrar bklags nas tshig gcig kyang brda ma 'jal nas the tshom du gyur nas/ e ma hoḥ sngags kyi tshul rtags sbyar na glegs bam 'di dag las ngo mtshar du gyur pa'i don chen po zhig yod par nges te/ bdag gis mi rtogs pa ci nyes snyam du bshum mo/ /de nas cung zad cig nas the tshom gyi rtog pa de dag zhi nas/ lo ka 'di na 'di dag brda 'jal ba su yod ces bsgrags nas/ za hor rgyal po u pa rā dza zhes bya ba mkhyen pa che bar yod do zhes zer nas/ pho nya ba brdzangs lo rgyus zhib tu gsol nas spyan drangs pas ma gnang ste/ gal te bdag gis ma shes na der phyin pa'i tshul ma yin gyi bsams nas 'dir skyol zhes smras so/ /der rgyal por bsnyad pas glang po che la bkal te gdan drangs pas tshig gcig kyang brda ma 'jal te/ bdag gi spyod yul du ma gyur pas rgyal po nyid kyi thugs kyis rjes su dpag 'tshal slar phar brdzangs so/ /de nas 'di khyi'i rgyal po lag thung dang*/ yum skra'i lwa ba can gyi bu dge slong ku ku rā dza zhes bya ba tshe lo stong thub byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang gi sprul pa de la bstan pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'u rtogs te bsgrub pas/ zhal mthong ste lung bstan pa/ gsang bdag dang mjal nas gsungs/ des rgyal po la bshad zer ba yod de/ 'grel sgrub nas gsal bas 'dir ma bshad do/ / 'dir rgyal po nyid kyi thun mong ma yin par rig ste/

sngar sangs rgyas kyi chos thos pa las byung ba bzhin du sgrib pa sbyangs ba dang tshogs bsags pa rgya chen po byas nas brtags pas/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'u dang brda 'jal bar gyur to/ /de bzhin du bsgrubs pas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal gzigs te/ glegs bam thams cad rtogs par gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na rang gi phung po skyongs shig khyod kyi ston pa ni gsang ba'i bdag po yin gyi/ de'i don ma lus pa ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dga' ba chen po skyes te/ de bzhin tu bskyed rim gyi phung po sbyangs pas/ sa dag kyang cher g.yos te/ badz+ra pā ṇi'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas de nyid kyi tshe badz+ra pā ṇi'i brtul zhugs mdzad/ rdo rje nam mkha' la spar nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ rdo rje 'dul ba la sogs pa'i tshig dang sngags brjod pas lo ka'i dregs pa can thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags bsdus pa'i tshul du 'khor du bsdus/ rdo rje gsang ba'i ming so sor btags nas lung gsang sgor phye ste/ dam pa'i mdzod sum brgya cher bshad pa ni/ rgyud yan lag bco brgyad la sogs par gsungs te/ de ltar phyag na rdo rjes rgyal po dza la gsungs/ des ku ku rā dza tshom bu 'bum sde la gsungs/ des rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi chen po 'khor tshom bu khri dang bcas pa la gsungs/ des singha rā dza tshom bu stong la/ des u pa rā dza tshom bu lnga brgya la/ des in+d+ra bo dhi'i sras mo go ma 'khor tshom bu brgya dang bcas pa la gsungs te/ de thams cad tshom bu'i tshogs bsgrubs pas rig 'dzin thob par gyur to/ /de ltar sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lam rim du gsungs pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po mngon gshegs nas/ /lha klu gnod sbyin srin po dang*/ mi las skal ldan 'dus pa las/ /dbang pos ji ltar lung bstan dus/ /rgyal bu rig can ltas shar nas/

/'brel pas snang ba mngon brtags pas/ /thugs kyi sgrub pa mngon rtogs te/ /de nyid bsgoms nas de nyid 'grub/ /bstan pa'i dngos grub de nas thob/ /don dam bcud kyis de nas rgyas/ /'dod pa'i bsam pa de nas 'grub/ /smon pa'i lha dang de ru mjal/ /de nas rdo rje gdan steng gi / 'dzam gling shar gyi phyogs mtshams su/ /pho brang rin chen dam pa der/ /bkra shis pa yi khang pa ru/ /ku ku rā dza in+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ singha u pa rā dza dang*/ /sras mo go ma sa la sogs/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbang thob nas/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mngon bsgrubs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang sar mngon du gshegs/ /zhes rig 'dzin brgyud pa kho na'o/ /de yang tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad du phye ba ni/ sku'i rgyud gsum/ gsung gi rgyud gsum/ thugs kyi rgyud gsum/ yon tan gyi rgyud gsum/ phrin las kyi rgyud gsum/ spyi rgyud gsum ste bco brgyad do/ /de la sku'i sku rgyud glang po rab 'bog sku'i gsung rgyud glang po chur 'jug sku'i thugs rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsung gi sku rgyud ri bo brtsegs pa/ gsung gi gsung rgyud pad+ma dbang chen/ gsung gi thugs rgyud zla gsang thig le'o/ /thugs kyi sku rgyud rtse mo 'dus pa/ thugs kyi gsung rgyud gcig las 'phros pa/ thugs kyi thugs rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ yon tan gyi sku rgyud sgron me 'bar ba/ yon tan gyi gsung rgyud bdud rtsi sa ma ya 'bum sde/ yon tan gyi thugs rgyud dpal mchog dang po/ phrin las kyi sku rgyud dpal phreng dkar mo/ phrin las kyi gsung rgyud ma mo rgyud lung*/ phrin las kyi thugs rgyud ta ma la 'bum sde/ spyi'i sku rgyud thabs zhags/ spyi'i gsung rgyud sa ma ya bkod pa/ spyi'i thugs rgyud gsang ba sgyu 'phrul lo/ /de ltar phye nas rgyal po dza la bshad do/ /thos chung log smra'i blo mig can gyi rigs kha cig na re/

sngags rnying ma'i rgyud la la yang dag pa ma yin/ rgya gar na mi 'dug zer ba sogs ni/ rang gi blo gros kyi mig long ba yin te/ rgya gar gyi thang bi ha ri'i gtsug lag khang na rnying ma'i chos skor rgyud kyi rgya dpe bzhugs pas mtshan yi ger bkod na bka' rgyas pa tsam bzhugs par grags/ de skad du dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'od srungs nga dang nga 'dra ba'i gang zag gis tshod gzung du rung gi gzhan dag ni las yin te log par ltung ba'i phyir ro/ /

zhes dang*/ mdo sde rgyan du/ mi rig pa yi gzugs la mi rigs na/ /the tshom za ba'i chos la smros ci dgos/ /de bas btang snyoms bzhag la nyes pa med//ces dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ ma mthong phyir na med pa min te/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ chos kyang yang dag pa ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs te/ sprul sku de la sngon 'byung gi da lta med do zhes kyang mi bsam ste rtag tu mos pa'i nges 'byung la/ des mdo dang rgyud sngar ma grags pa gsal bar mdzad pa'ang srid pas skur pa mi gdab pa/ chos gang la thar pa'i lam du 'jug cing 'khor ba spang bar ston pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab tshad mar bzhag ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ khams gsum dag na nyon mongs spong byed gsung zhi ba'i yon tan brjod par mdzad pa gang*/ de ni drang srong gsung yin ldog pa gzhan/ /zhes so/ /sangs rgyas ni rtag par bzhugs pas gdul bya'i don mdzad la/ byin rlabs kyi bka' yang ri dang shing dang pad+ma dang dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ skyes pa dang*/ bud med dang*/ bu mo dang*/ bya dang*/ ri dwags la sogs chos kyi rnam grangs kyi sgra byung ba de yang bkar gsungs pa yod na/ sngar byung gi da lta mi srid ces log par mi lta ste/ byin gyis brlabs pa dag 'byung srid pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gang la yid ches pa dam par bzung nas yi dam du byas pa 'thad kyi/ gzhan la skur ba nam yang gdab par mi bya'o/ /gsang sngags rnying ma'i nang nas rdzogs pa chen po'i chos 'ga' zhig las lha gnas gsum dang 'og min du gsungs pa rnams gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pas tshig tu btus te gser gyi glegs bam la baiḍūr ya zhun mas bris te/ rgya rang mnan du byas te dgongs pa'i rtsal bdun gyi nam mkha' la sbas pa la/ da ltar gsang ba'i rgyud sde rnams mi'i yul du ji ltar babs pa ni/ rgyud la la rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi chen po'i don du byung*/

rgyud la la rgyal po dza'i khang thog tu glegs bam gyi char pa babs/ rgyud la la mi'iyul nas byung*/ rgyud la la gnod sbyin dang srin po dang gshin rje'i yul nas brgyud de byung*/ rgyud la la sbyang ba'i don ldan rnams kyi don ri ma la ya'i rtse nas byung*/ rgyud la la 'og min gyi gnas nas rgya mtsho'i gling du brgyud de byung*/ rgyud la la mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas nas brgyud de byung ba'o/ /'o na ji ltar na sngon bcom ldan 'das 'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ sprul pa'i nyan thos rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa dag gling 'di nas gzhan du gshegs pa/ nam mkha' la lam byung nas 'gro ba rgyal pos gzigs te/ 'khor rnams la ji yin dris pas/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor sprul pa'i nyan thos dag gling gzhan du gshegs pa yin no zhes gsol pas/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba 'di lta bu gang gi mthu yin zhes pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu yin zhes gsol pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas de bzhin gshegs pa ni gang*/ sangs rgyas ni su zhig yin gsungs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa zhes bya ba da lta bya rgod phung po'i ri la sogs pa'i gnas na 'khor dgra bcom pa dang bcas nas bzhugs so zhes gsol pas/ rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ de lta bu'i skyes bu de bdag gi khab tu spyan drongs shig gsungs pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dgra bcom dang bcas pa spyan drangs te gdugs tshod sbyar te/ rgyal pos gsol pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa che ba'i yon tan 'di dag gang las byung zhes gsol pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge ba'i tshogs rnam par dkar ba bsags pa las byung zhes so/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ bdag kyang de bzhin du spyad par bgyi gnang zhes gsol pas/ bka' stsal pa/ de ltar legs shig sras dang btsun mo spangs la rab tu byung ste pha rol tu phyin pa drug sgrubs shig ces bka' stsal pas/

rgyal pos gsol pa/ de ltar mi nus te btsun mo dang bcas par byang chub thob pa'i chos shig zhu 'tshal zhes gsol pa dang*/ skad cig de nyid la rigs drug pa'i dkyil 'khor snang bar mdzad/ dbang bskur te/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la bka' bsgos ta ེ / sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa mdzad/ dus la babs pas shod cig ces pas sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba'i rgyud rtogs pa bcu slob bu'i don du bshad do/ /de nas rgyal pos rgyud lnga sde'i don thugs su chud de bsgrubs pas/ 'khor 'bum tsho dang bcas pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa thob/ gdams ngag khyi'i mkhan po la bzhag go / skagasang 'dus lo rgyus las/ gzhan gong bzhin la/ skad cig de nyid la ston pa rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs su mdzad de 'og min du gshegs nas gsang 'dus gsungs zhes zer ro / / yang de las/ in+d+ra bo dhi zhes pa dang po'i mgon po ste/ o rgyan yul gyi rgyal po min par bshad pa dang*/ yang rnam pa cig tu na/ } in+d+ra bo dhi chen po'i sras rgyal po dza zhes bya ba'i sku ring la/ za hor gyi yul na drag shul can gyi ri ma la ya zhes bya ba yod de/ ri de yang rtse mo na ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge 'khrab pa yod pa/ 'dabs la gcan gzan stag gi tshang yod pa/ logs la brag dkar po seng ge gnam du mchong ba 'dra ba yod pa de la shing sna tshogs 'bras bur ldan pa skyes pa/ de'i shar phyogs na kri sha a nu ta ra zhes bya ba'i brag phug yod pas sgo la ngo mtshar can gyi ri mo rang byung du yod pa/ bu dkar rin po che zur brgyad nyi zla'i rol mo rang snang ba spyi bo na bya ka lan ta ka'i tshang byas pa/ rtsa bar bdud rtsi'i chu mig yod pa/ mdun na me tog sna tshogs pa'i tshal yod pa/ shing gi yal ga phyogs bzhir gyes pa/ dus bzhi'i gnod pa las skyob pa/ shing de'i 'bru sman du gyur te/ zos pas nad sna tshogs sel ba/ ri de'i rked pa na mkhar yang thog gsum yod pa'i bar khang na/

skal ldan gyi rgyal po dza nyid bzhugs te/ de yang sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad lon pa'i tshe/ cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i rgyal gyi nyi ma la ngo mtshar can gyi ltas sna tshogs byung nas/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas mchod pa rgya chen po bshams nas/ des nub mo pho brang grong khyer dang bcas pa/ ri bo me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mo dang bcas 'od kyis gang bar byas so/ /de'i rjes su bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rjes/ bstan pa gsang sngags kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus la bab ste/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje mngon par gshegs te/ 'khor dam pa'i rigs can lha'i rigs grags ldan mchog skyong*/ klu rgyal 'jog po/ gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong*/ srin po blo gros thabs ldan/ mi las skal ldan li tsa bī dri ma med pa dang lnga 'dus pa las/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'khor bskor zhing*/ srin po blo gros thabs ldan gyis yi ger bsdus pa'i byin rlabs gnang ngo*/ de'i dus su rgyal po dza la rmis ltas bdun shar tshul gong du smos pa ltar la/ de nas yab rgyal po la ga thung dang yum skra'i lwa ba can gyi bu dge slong ku ku rā dza bya ba mkhyen pa che zhing*/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi slob ma yin par dgongs te snyam nas/ glang po che'i khal du byas te slob dpon ku ku rā dza la bskyal te don 'grol bar zhus pas/ slob dpon des kyang dang po ma mkhyen te 'di skad smras so/ /'phags pa ni thugs rje re chung*/ bdag ni las 'phro re zhan/ tan+t+ra ni tshig gcig tsam yang ma rtogs zhes yan lag sa la brdabs pas/ de'i nub mo rmi lam du dpal rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi zhal bstan nas/ rigs kyi bu sems ma zhi bar spro ba bskyed la gang rtogs pa de'i gzhung ltar sgrubs shig gsungs so/ /de nas nam langs nas glegs bam la gzigs pas/ dpal gsang ba snying po'i gzhung las/

rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'u thugs su chud de/ de'i gzhung bzhin bsgrubs pas/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal mthong ste/ rigs kyi bu dngos grub ci 'dod gsungs pa la/ dngos grub rnam pa gsum 'tshal te/ de la glegs bam 'di rnams kyi don shes pa/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don 'grub pa/ mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub 'grub pa zhig 'tshal lo zhes zhus pas/ de bzhin du gyur cig gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur te/ der slob dpon chen po ku ku rā dzas glegs bam de dag gzigs pas/ tshig don thams cad thugs su chud de tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad du phye ba yin no skad/ 'chad lugs gcig la gong lta bu'o/ /bab tshul 'di dag 'gyur phyi ma dang khung mthun par 'byung ste/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'-i rgyud phyi ma las/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'da' khar 'jam dpal gyis zhus pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'di kho nar 'dug gam zhes gsol pas/ bka' stsal pa/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /mi las skal ldan mchog gyur pa/ / rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /lag na rdo rjes ston par 'gyur/ / zhes dang*/ gsang ba'i snying po'i rgyud phyi ma las/ re zhig snod dang ldan pa'i mi/ /de ming rgyal po dza zhes bya/ /lag na rdo rje'i mthus snang 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ mdo chen po las/ mi yi gnas kyi 'jig rten khams/ / gling bzhi pa la 'dzam gling gi /drag shul can zhes bya ba'i ri/ /gnod sbyin 'dul ba'i gnas yin te/ /chos 'dzin rigs kyi sgrub gnas yin/ /zhes mdo rgyud du ma nas gsungs te/ rgyud la la mi'i gnas nas byung ba ni/ tā tha saṃ gra ha'i rgyud de/ 'di skad du/ mi yi yul du babs nas su/ /sems can kun gyi don bya'i phyir/ rdo rje theg pa mchog skor zhig /mgon po rab tu gshegs par mdzod/

/ces pas ri rab kyi rtse mo de nyid nas sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'dzam bu'i gling yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir bkye ste/ lho phyogs gyad kyi yul nags tshal dra ba can gyi mdo/ skyes bu 'byung ba'i gnas zhes bya ba der 'phags pa 'jam dpal du sprul nas/ 'jam dpal gyi le'u khri drug stong dang*/ bshad rgyud cho ga 'dus pa le'u nyis stong bdun brgya ba dang dka' ba yongs su spyod pa'i rgyud sh+lau ka sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa bshad do/ /bsil ba'i tshal du ston pa rigs gsum mgon pos kri ya thams cad bshad do/ /nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul du mchod rten dpal 'bras kyi nang*/ gan+dho la'i dri gtsang khang reg pa med pa'i gdugs can gyi nang du/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen he badz+ra du sprul nas/ dgyes pa rdo rje 'bum tsho lnga'i bdag nyid bshad rgyud bzhi dang bcas pa bshad de 'dzam bu'i gling khyad par can gyi yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen pos bde mchog 'khor lo'i bshad rgyud dang bcas pa bshad do/ /ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse la 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed du sprul nas gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud kha cig gsungs so/ / dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas su ston pa he rus/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ ma hā mā yā la sogs pa bshad do/ /smre khrod kyi grong khyer du gsang sngags nang gi rgyud mang po gsungs so/ /ri bya rkang can du yang gsungs/ de ltar du mi yul du gsungs pa zhes de rnams kyang kha cig ni mkha' 'gro ma dang lha klu rnams kyis spyan drangs te phyis grub pa thob pa rnams kyis de dag gi yul nas spyan drangs/ kha cig ni dus de nyid nas mi yul du brgyud do/ /gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ gshin rje'i gnas nas 'byung ba ni/ gnod sbyin gyi gnas nas/ dpal rdo rje gur gyi rgyud la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon gsang ba pas/

slob dpon mthu stobs rā dza la phyis bshad do/ /srin po'i yul nas byung ba ni dpal 'byung ba dang dpal dam pa'i rgyud/ de'i yan lag dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos grong khyer dga' ba can du slob dpon in+d+ra bo dhi bar ma la bshad do/ /gshin rjes yul nas byung ba ni dgra nag gi rgyud kha cig dang*/ kha thun zla gsang la sogs pa gshin rje'i rgyud mang po slob dpon la li ta badz+ra gyis spyan drangs te slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la bshad/ yang lung {ri ma la ya'i rtser lag na rdo rjes mchan/snga a nu yo ga'i mdo rnams dam pa'i rigs can lnga la gsungs pa ni tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad dus mtshungs zhes pa'ang snang ngo*/ /de yang kri ya rnams wā ra ṇā sir babs/ yo ga rnams me ri 'bar bar babs/ ma hā yo ga rnams rgyal po dza'i khang thog tu babs/ a nu yo ga rnams ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse la babs/ a ti yo ga rnams o rgyan dha na ko ṣa'i gling du babs/ rgyud sde gzhan rnams ni dngos su pu ti babs pa yin/ a ti yo ga ni de ltar ma yin ta/ rdo rje sems dpa'i slob ma lha'i bu kun dga' snying po zhes bya ba/ rgyal po u pa rā dza dang*/ snang gsal 'od ldan gnyis kyi sras mo su dharma'i sras su 'khrungs shing*/ 'og min du dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i dbang dang*/ yang gsang bla na med pa'i gdams pa dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par zhus te gnas pa las/ de nas sngar gyi sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i sde snod dang*/ khyad par du rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi thugs la bzhugs pa rnams ri ma la ya rin po che rnam par sprul pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma bde ba'i ro ldan ma dang*/ bde byed ser mo yon tan mtha' yas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis zhus ta/ lo gsum du yi ger bkod nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'du ba'i phug tu bzhugs so/

/de yang rnying ma la'ang bya rgyud spyod rgyud/ de gnyis ka'i rgyud*/ rnal 'byor rgyud gsum/ phyi ma la rnal 'byor tsam dang*/ rnal 'byor bla med de nang tshan phye na rgyud sde bzhi'o/ /bka' brgyad spyi'i rgyud la'ang*/ lta spyod 'dus pa nam mkha' che'i rgyud/ che mchog rol pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ khrag 'thung rol pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ gshin rje rol pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rta mchog rol pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ phur pa rol pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ ma mo rol pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rig 'dzin rol pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ drag sngags rol pa rtsa ba'i rgyud rnams gsungs so/ /de yang rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i rgyud/ phyi ma'i phyi ma'i rgyud/ ma tshang ba kha skong ba'i rgyud/ 'byed par byed pa lde mig gi rgyud dang lnga'o/ de yang ston pa ni kun tu bzang po ste rgyud 'chad pa'o/ /chos ni gong du smos pa'i rgyud sde rnams so/ /sdud pa po ni rig 'dzin rdo rje chos te/ mi'i thod pa can rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes bya bas bsdus nas yi ger bkod pa'o/ /don tshan ni kri ya nas a ti'i bar te drug go /de nas rgyud rnams mkha' 'gro dang sde brgyad la gtad nas sbed par brtsam pa'i tshe so so'i gnas su sbed par 'dod da/ blo ma mthun pa las mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo ches/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i nang du sbas so/ /de nas dus phyis slob dpon brgyad kyis 'don par 'dod de der tshogs nas mkha' 'gro ma la gtor ma phul gsol ba btab pa'i tshe mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis 'di skad zhus so/ e ma ho/ sku ni lhar gsal gsung ni sngags su sgrogs/ /thugs ni mnyam nyid rdo rje lta bu'o/ /sbrul pa sna tshogs 'phro ba'i slob dpon brgyad/ /bka' ni ci stsal gsung ni gang gsungs nyan/ zhes zhus pas/ e ma ho 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs ma mo ḍā ki dang*/ /bdud dang gshin rje la sogs bdag la nyon/

/bka' bzhin byed pa khyed rnams mchod byed pa/ /sgrom bu dgu po de rnams khur la shog /ces gsungs pas/ slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra la he ru ka gal po la sogs pa yang dag thugs kyi rgyud rnams gtad/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la 'jam dpal gsang rgyud la sogs gshin rje'i rgyud rnams gtad/ klu sgrub la rta mchog rol pa la sogs pad+ma gsung gi rgyud rnams gtad/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la bi to ta ma la sogs phur ba phrin las kyi rgyud rnams gtad/ bi ma la mi tra la bdud rtsi rol pa'i rgyud sogs bdud rtsi yon tan gyi rgyud rnams gtad/ dhā na saṃ skṛ ta la rgyud lung 'bum tig la sogs ma mo'i rgyud rnams gtad/ ro mū gu h+ya dā+e dza tsan+d+ra la sku'i rgyud dregs pa 'dus pa sogs 'jig rten dreg pa can gyi rgyud rnams gtad/ phung byed shīn+taṃ gar+bha la drag sngags shel phreng dkar po'i rgyud sogs dmod pa drag sngags kyi rgyud rnams gtad/ bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud rnams slob dpon thun mong du gtad nas/ slar yang mchod rten du bcug go /so sor gtad pa'i rgyud rnams yongs su rgyas par bya'o/ /des nas slob dpon chen po pad+mas slar mchod rten de nyid bde gshegs 'dus pa bton nas yang le shod kyi brag phug tu bder 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas bsgrubs pas phyag rgya chen po mchog grub rig 'dzin brgyad la bder 'dus kyi dbang bskur nas rig 'dzin brgyad kyi bla ma yang mdzad/ de nas slob dpon pad+ma bod du spyan drangs/ bsam yas su phebs nas rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan rje blon 'bangs dang bcas brgyad la bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang bskur/ rigs kyi me tog dor ba na/ rgyal po'i me tog dbus su che mchog la bab/ gnubs nam mkha'i snying po'i me tog shar yang dag la bab/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rig 'dzin lho gshin rje la bab/

ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs nub dbang chen la/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi me tog byang rdo rje gzhon nu/ 'brog ban dpal gyi ye shes kyi me tog shar lho ma mo la/ rlangs dpal gyi me tog nub byang dregs pa kun 'dul la bab/ pa gor bai ro tsa na'i me tog byang shar dmod pa drag sngags la phog cing*/ thams cad dus so so'i grub pa thob bo/

/'o na gsang sngags rnying ma'i dpe tsam rgya gar na yang mi bzhugs sam snyam na/ rgyal blon snga dar gyi dus slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ bi ma la mi tra la sogs pas paṇ+ḍi ta bgyis/ bai ro tsa na dang*/ gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra/ cog gru klu'i rgyal mtshan/ rma rin chen mchog /a tsar ya ye shes dbyangs la sogs pas lo tsā bgyis te/ phyi nang gi rgyud sde ma lus pa bod du bsgyur ba yin/ 'dir yi ges 'jigs pas rgyas par ma 'khod do/ /man ngag rdzogs pa chen po shin tu gsang ba kun gyi spyod yul du ma gyur te rdo rje gdan gyi 'og tu sbas la/ khyim bdag dge ldan bzang po dang*/ yum snang gsal dge ldan ma gnyis la sras shṝ sidha 'khrungs te/ lo bco lnga la slob dpon ha ti bha la'i drung du sgra tshad brtsi ba sogs rig gnas lnga la mkhas par bslabs/ lo nyi shu rtsa lnga la theg pa mchog gi rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa'i dbang khrid zhus nas nyams su blangs/ shṝ singhas bag tsam bton nas bai ro tsa na la bshad/ lhag ma sbas nas yod pa bi ma la rgya gar na bzhugs dus bod yul na rgyal po'i bla mchod nyang ting 'dzin bzang po zhes bya ba sha'i spyan gyis gling bzhi dus gcig la gzigs pa zhig yod pa des paṇa chen gyi yon tan gzigs nas rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan la rgyu mtshan zhus te/ rgyal pos rgya gar rgyal po la gser gyi 'bul ba bskur nas/ phyi'i lo tsā ba rang du bcug pa'i snying nang dang*/ bi ma la mi tra dpon g.yog gis rgyal po dang paṇ+ḍi ta rnams la zhu ba phul ba/ bdag bod du mchis phan chad/ bod du sngon chad yongs su ma grags pa'i chos skor zhig bsgyur dgos byas pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta rnams na re/ rdo rje gdan gyi 'og na man ngag gi chos sbas nas yod pa de 'o skol rgya gar la spyod dbang med na yang*/ khyod bod du 'gro ba la shin tu yus che ba yin pas/ ji ltar rigs pa thon la khyer zer bas/

bi ma la dpon g.yog gis chos ma lus pa spyan drangs nas rgya gar gyi dpe rtsad chod ces grags/ bi ma la bsam yas su phebs/ mdo sngags spyi dang*/ khyad par theg dgu/ rdzogs chen gyi sde gsum chos mtha' dag bsgyur nas/ mthar rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa gnas kyi bar du bzhugs shing lo brgya na sprul pa re bod du 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no/ /de rnams ni brgyud pa gsum gyi gsang sngags kyi babs tshul spyir bstan pa ste/ da ni bye brag tu chos kyi rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ theg pa thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs so/ /dang po gsum ste/ sgra don dang*/ dbye ba/ 'bras bu'o/ dang po ni/ ya na'isgra las theg pa ste gang la bstan nas bgrod par 'dod pas phyin cing skyel ba zhes te/ sdud pa las/ theg pa 'di ni mkha' 'dra gzhal med khang*/ /dga' skyid bde ba mngon par thob byed theg pa'i mchog /de gang zhe na sems can thams cad mya ngan 'das/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ spyir dbye ba dang bye brag tu dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni sems can gyi rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjes gang la gang 'dul du bstan pas theg pa'i rnam grangs kyang 'di nyid kho nar nges so zhes 'chad pa med da/ lang kar gshegs pa la/ sems can rnams n-i yongs drang phyir/ /theg pa tha dag nges bshad do/ /'di zhes dmigs su yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ de yang re zhig bsdu na 'bras bu la dgongs te gcig tu gsungs pa yin/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las/ theg pa gnyis su yod ma yin/ /zhes dang*/ kun byed las/ yod ni gcig las med pa las/ /zhes so/ /yang rgyu dang 'bras bu la dgongs nas gnyis te/ chen po dang chung ngu la dgongs nas gnyis su gsungs ta/ dpal 'byung bzhi zad pa'i rgyud las/ rgyu chos rnams dang 'bras bu'i phyir/ /theg pa de yang rnam pa gnyis/

/zhes dang*/ ye sgron las/ che chung rim pa'i blo yod phyir/ /theg pa'i grangs kyang de bzhin te/ /bsdu na che chung rnam gnyis yod/ /ces so/ /yang che 'bring gis dbye ba'i nyan rang theg pa chen po ste gsum du gsungs te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyor ba dang ni tshogs dag la/ /bsam pa dang ni bshad nyid dang*/ /sgrub pa'i rab tu dbye ba yis/ /theg pa rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /ces dang*/ gsang pa thig le nor bu'i rgyud las/ phyi nang gi rim pas kyang gsum du bshad de/ phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang rab tu gsungs/ /zhes so/ /yang rgyu'i theg pa gsum 'bras bu dang bzhir yang bshad/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /zhes dang*/ bam brgyad las/ bsam gyis mi khyab bstan pa 'di/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong rnam grangs kyang*/ /theg pa'i sgo ni gsum du gsungs/ /gsang nyid theg par bsdus dang bzhi/ /zhes so/ /yang rnam grangs bsdu ba lngar bshad de/ gsang rnying las/ theg pa bzhi yi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas//zhes dang*/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ lha yi theg dang tshangs pa'i theg /de bzhin du ni nyan thos dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs dang rang rgyal gyi//theg pa tha dad par bshad do/ /zhes so/ yang sgyu 'phrul gyis gong 'og dbye ba'i drug tu yang bshad de/ kun byed las/ nges par thob pa'i theg pa drug /ces so/ / bdun du yang bshad de/ dkyil 'khor bsdu pa las/ lha dang mi dang nyan thos dang*/ /rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /gsang ba phyi dang nang gnyis te/ /de ltar theg pa bdun du bshad/ /ces so/ /brgyad du yang bshad de*/ nam mkha' che las/ de ltar theg brgyad las 'das pa'i/ /zhes dang*/ dgur yang bshad de/ kun byed las/ byung ni theg pa dgu ru byung*/ /zhes so/ /yang sor bzhag lha mi'i theg pa gnyis/ phyi rol pa'i sde lnga/ nang pa'i rim dgu/

'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i theg pa dang bcu drug tu yang bshad de/ snying po nyi ma snang byed kyi rgyud las/ theg pa'i dang po bcu drug mgon/ /zhes dang*/ yang bsam gyis mi khyab par bshad de/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ ji srid sems ni 'jug pa'i bar/ /theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /yang gnas lugs la theg pa zhes btags pa tsam las grub pa med de/ de nyid las/ sems ni nam zhig gyur pa na/ /theg pa med cing 'gro ba'ang med/ /ces so/ /mdor na thams cad blo'i rim pa las snang ba tsam las blo ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la ni theg pa zhes pa'ang gzhi nas med pa'i nam mkha' bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu dbye ba la gnyis te/ khyad par 'phags tshul dang*/ gsang sngags nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rim pa bzhin nyan rang gi theg pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang*/ theg pa chen po rnams kyi phyi ma phyi ma mchog sta/ mdo sde rgyan las/ nyan thos rnams kyi 'byor pas ni/ /'jig rten pa ni zil gyis gnon/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi 'byor pas ni/ /nyan thos nyid kyang zil gyis gnon/ /de yis byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /'byor pa'i char yang mi phod do/ /de yis de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /'byor pa'i char yang mi phod do/ /zhes sogs theg chen de yang khyad par 'phags tshul gyi rnam grangs mang na'ang bsdu na bdun du 'dus te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang*/ /ye shes brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang*/ /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*/ /yang dag sgrub pa chen po dang*/ /sangs rgyas phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod/ /ces so/ /de las kyang gsang sngags 'bras bu'i theg pa khyad par 'phags te/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ / thabs mang dka' ba med phyir dang*/ /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/

/ sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang*/ mdo gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal por/ 'jam dpal gyis ston pa la/ 'dren pa'i theg pa gsum po dag /bcom ldan nges par gsungs lags na/ /rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod cing*/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i/ /nges pa'i theg pa cis ma gsungs/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ ston pas/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ 'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam ni/ /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes sngags ni 'bras bu lam du byed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rang la yod pa nges don mthar thug gi theg pa ste/ lung 'di gnyis kyis sdom gsum rab dbyer/ pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las/ /lhag pa'i lta ba yod na ni/ /lta de spros pa can du 'gyur/ /zhes pa la gnod de/ lung snga ma'i ma rmongs pa dang*/ dbang po rnon po zhes pa ni/ mdo las sngags shes rab tu zhugs pa'i lta ba'ang de'i khyad par nyid dang*/ lung phyi ma'i rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu zhes sogs kyis rdo rje theg pa zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ye shes mngon du byed pa'o/ /de yang rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ / sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la'o/ / zhes snga ma snga ma bas phyi ma phyi ma mchog tu gsungs so/ /gnyis pa sngags nyid bshad pa la gnyis te/ rgyud sde bzhir grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ rnam grangs so sor bstan pa'o/ /dang po la lnga las/ dang po mi rigs bzhi la dgongs nas gsungs pa ni/ bram ze khrus dang gtsang sbra gtso 'khor ston pa la bya rgyud/ rje'u rigs phyi khrus dang gtsang sbra nang ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyis gnas pa la spyod rgyud/ rgyal rigs yon tan dang 'byor pas yul skyong ba la rnal 'byor rgyud/ dmangs rigs gtsang btsog chung zhing nyon mongs rags par spyod pa la bla med rgyud gsungs te/

bde mchog rol pa'i rgyud las/ bya ba bram ze gtsang dang bstun/ /spyod pa rje'u rigs de bas lhag /rnal 'byor rgyal po'i 'khor tshogs mang*/ /gzhi dmangs gdod nas grol ba ste/ / gzhan du su la'ang ma bstan par/ /mdzes ma khyod la bstan pa ni/ /zhes dang*/ dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud las/ bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang*/ /dmangs rigs gdol ba 'dul don du/ /rgyud ni rnam pa bzhir gdungs te/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med do/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa gang zag gi blo rigs bzhi la dgongs nas gsungs pa ni/ dbang po tha ma la bya ba/ 'bring la spyod pa/ rab la rnal 'byor/ yang rab bla med de/ gur du lung sngar drangs zin pa ltar ro/ gsum pa dus la ltos nas bzhir gsungs te/ bskal pa dang po rdzogs ldan gyi dus su bya rgyud/ sum ldan gyis dus su spyod rgyud/ gnyis ldan la rnal 'byor rgyud/ rtsod ldan la bla med do/ /lha thams cad yang dag pa 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ rdzogs ldan dang po bya ba'i rgyud/ /sum ldan gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud/ /gnyis ldan gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rtsod ldan bzhi pa bla med do/ /dus bzhi la ni dgongs nas kyang*/ rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhir bshad do/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa spyad gzhi 'dod chags kyi 'jug tshul bzhi la dgongs nas bzhir gsungs te/ rdzogs ldan gyi dus su nyon mongs pa shas chung bas bltas pas tshim pa la bya rgyud de/ rdo rje gtsug tor las/ dkar pos ras la brtag bya zhing*/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni lha tshogs rnams/ /mo yang pho la blta ba dang*/ /pho yang mo la blta ba bri/ /zhes so/ /sum ldan gyi dus su bgad pas tshim pa'i 'dod chags byung ste de'i don du spyod pa'i rgyud de/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ mgon po ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ /de yi g.yon phyogs lha mo ni/ /cung zad mig gi 'dzums bcas bri/ /zhes so/ /gnyis ldan gyi dus su reg cing 'khyud pas tshim pa'i 'dod chags can la rnal 'byor rgyud de/

dpal mchog dang po las/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni lha tshogs rnams/ /dpung pa yid tsam bsdam par bzhag /zhes so/de nas yo ga'i lha rnams phyag rgya 'brel bar 'byung ngo*/ /rtsod ldan gyi dus su dbang po gnyis spyod gyi 'dod chags can 'dul don du bla med de/ brtag gnyis las/ bo la kak+ko la sbyar pas/ /de yi bde ba khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ dbang po gnyis kyis sbyaur ba yis/ / dngos po thams cad brtag par bya/ /zhes dang*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ mtshan ma gnyis la bsngags byas te/ /sngags pas mkha' 'gro ma la sbyar/ / zhes so/ /'dod lha'i rim pa yang bzhag ste/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyis bltas pas tshim pa la bya ba/ 'phrul dga' bgad pas tshim pa la spyod pa/ dga' ldan la sogs lag bcang la rnal 'byor/ sum cu rtsa gsum man chad dbang po gnyis sbyor ba bla med/ sam+bu ṭa las/ bltas dang bgad dang lag bcang dang*/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa gang yin la/ /srin bu yi ni tshul gyis su/ /rgyud ni rnam pa bzhir gsungs so/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa lha bzhi'i rjes su 'jug pa phyin ci log pa bzhi ni/ gti mug tshangs pa gtsang sbra chos su smra ste/ bsam gtan phyi ma las/ 'dag chal dag gis bgos pa'i gos/ /dri ma med par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /lus la mchod sbyin gyis bgos la/ /'bab stegs bkrus pa de yis dag /ces pa'i tshul gyis bya rgyud do/ /zhe sdang khyab 'jug 'tshe ba chos su smra ba'i don du spyod rgyud de/ legs par grub pa las/ rgyal rigs la ni rgyal rigs dang*/ /bram ze la ni bram ze bsad/ /rnam snang mngon byung las/ e ma ho gsod pa 'di ni bzang*/ /bsad pas byung chub thob par byed/ /ces so/ /nga rgyal brgya byin rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rnal 'byor rgyud de/ /dbang phyug 'byor pa lha yi rgyud/ /rnal 'byor yang dag bshad pa 'o/ /zhes so/ /'dod chags can dbang phyug ni 'dod chags chos su smra ste/

gau taṃ bud med me yin te/ /de yi nye gnas thab khung yin/ /zhes pa 'dul ba bla mar gsungs te/ gsang 'dus las/ bud med gzugs dang mdangs bzang ma/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa la/ /byin gyis brlabs te lan gsum du/ /dben par mchod par rab tu brtsams// gnyis pa rnam grangs so sor nges pa la phyi nang gnyis so/ /dang po la gsum/ bya spyod rnam 'byor/ dang po la gnyis/ nges tshig ni kri ya ste/ khrus dang gtsang sbra gtso bor ston pa bya rgyud de/ dbye na gsum las/ gzhi chos rnams ngo bo nyid med par rtogs nas lha ye shes sems dpa' rgyal po lta bu la dngos grub 'dod pa'i gzhir byed do/ /lam ni lha bskyed nas mchod pa 'bul bas de kho na nyid la sogs pas dka' spyad dang gtsang sbra'i rang bzhin la brten no/ / 'bras bu mi tshe bcu drug na sangs rgyas nas byang chub thob par 'dod de/ kun byed las/ kri yas bdag dang lha gnyis rje khol tshul/ /mi tshe bcu drug 'bad pas grol ba thob/ /zhes so/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la'ang gnyis/ nges tshig u pa ya ste spyod pa kri ya dang mthun zhing sgom pa yo ga dang mthun nas gnyis bcas kyi theg pa zhes so/ /dbye na gsum/ gzhi ngo bo nyid med pa'i shes rab dang lha gnyis dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa'i tshul du mnyam par 'dod pa'i thabs la dngos grub 'dod pa'i rtogs pa'o/ /lam de ltar bsgom zhing kri ya ltar gtsang sbra spyod pas mi tshe bdun nas grol bar 'dod pa 'bras bu ste/ snga ma las/ u pa bdag dang lha gnyis mnyam por mthong*/ /grogs po'i tshul gyis dngos grub ster 'dod pa/ /mi tshe bdun na grol ba'i dngos grub thob/ /ces so/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la'ang gnyis/ nges tshig ni yo ga ste sems kyi gtso la lta spyod gnyis grogs su 'dod pa'o/ /dbye na gsum las/ gzhi ngo bo nyid med pa'i shes rab dang*/ bdag lhar gsal ba la ye shes pa chu la chu bzhag pa ltar gnas pas gzhir byed pa'o/

/lam de ltar bsgom zhing gtsang sbra kun tu spyod pa grogs su ldan pas/ mi tshe gsum na stug po bkod pa'i sar grol bar 'dod de/ snga ma las/ yo ga stug po bkod 'dod pa/ /mi tshe gsum na grol bar 'dod/ /

ces so/ gsang sngags nang pa gsum ste/ dang po rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la'ang gnyis las/ nges tshig ni ma hā yo ga'i sgra las thabs kyi rnal 'byor bskyed pa dang*/ rlung gtso bor grol bar bshad do/ /dbye na gsum las/ ye nas dag pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor rlung gi byed pa'o/ /lam ni de dag sgom pa'o/ /'bras bu ni tshe 'di nyid la grol bar 'dod pa ste/ ye shes rol pa las/ bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa las/ /ye shes rlung gis las byed cing*/ nam mkha'i 'jo ba rab rdzogs pa'i/ /tshe gcig gis ni rab grol lo/ /zhes so/ shes rab ma'i rgyud la'ang gnyis las/ nges tshig ni a nu yo ga ste shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med du 'dod pa'o/ /dbye na gnyis las/ gzhi ye nas dag pa lha'i rang bzhin dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'o/ /lam de nyid sgom pa'o/ /'bras bu tshe 'dir bde ba chen po'i sku mngon du byed pa'o/ /thig le mchog gi rgyud las/ 'od gsal ba yi mtshan nyid 'di/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med par/ /bde ba chen po su bsgom pa/ /'bras bu tshe 'dir rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes so/ / gnyis su med pa'i rgyud la'ang gnyis las/ nges tshig ni/ a ti'i sgra las/ skye ba med ba'i ngo bo nyid kun gyi snying po la 'jug pas chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i don no/ /dbye ba ni gsum las/ gzhi snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos so cog ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin no/ /lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis su blang dor re dog las 'das par byed pa'o/ /'bras bu lhun rdzogs kun tu bzang po'i sa la da lta nyid nas gnas par mthar phyin par byed pa ste/ theg pa 'dir thams cad rdzogs pa ste/ le lag las/ mnyam nyid don rtogs rang rig rgyal po dang*/ /bla med don rtogs thabs chen 'di dag tu/ /rgya mtsho chen por chu klung kun babs ltar/ /rnam par thar pa bsam yas ma lus

'dus/ /zhes so/ /'di dag ni smin byed dbang gi rim pa gnyis/ /dang po ni/ rgyud sde gang du dbang bzhi tshang ba mi ston zhing*/ khyad par du rig pa'i dbang tsam las mi 'dod pa ni phyi pa ste/ dpal ye shes gsang pa'i rgyud las/ bum pa chu yis dbang bskur bas/ /bya ba'i rgyud la zhugs pa ste/ /cod pan gyis ni dbang bskur bas/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la zhugs pa yin/ /rdo rje dril bu byin pa yis// rnal 'byor rgyud du rtogs pa dang*/ /zhes so/ /ye shes thig le las/ chu yi dbang bskur cod pan dbang*/ /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming*/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu gsal/ /phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar bya/ /de nas drug gi bye brag dbang*/ /de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya/ /rnal 'byor bla ma yi ni mtshan/ /gsang ba yi ni dbang rgyal bshad/ /shes rab ye shes bla na med/ /bzhi pa de ltar de bzhin no/ /zhes bum pa'i dbang yan chad phyi pa'o/ /rgyud sde gang du dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba nang pa yin te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ bum pa'i dbang bskur dang po ste// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur dang*/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes te/ /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa 'bras bu la gnyis te/ nges tshig dang dbye ba'o/ /dang po bid+yā dhā ra zhes pas/ bid+yā dhā ni rig pa ste/ shes rab ye shes kyi sangs rgyas kyi gdung ngo*/ /dhā ra ni 'dzin zhing 'chang ba ste/ don la slob pa pa'am ldan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang*/ rang bzhin bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dri med bshags rgyud las/ rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun gyis grub/ ces pas/ rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin ni/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin/ lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin no/ dang po mtshan nyid gsum ldan te/

yi dam lha'i rnal 'byor du smin pa/ lus rnam smin gyi gzugs las gnas ma gyur pa lus rgya dang bral nas phyag rgya chen po'i sku thob pa ste/ rngam glog las/ yid kyis lha yi gzugs bzung zhing*/ /lus kyi rgya mdud grol gyur nas/ /phyag rgya'i sku nyid gsal gyur pa/ /lus rgya dang bral nas phyag rgya chen po'i sku thob pa ste/ /zhes so/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam smin gyi lus rdo rje lus su gyur te de nyid ma spangs par sangs rgyas kyi sa la sbyor bas phung po'i zag pa med cing ye shes kyi blo skyes pa ste/ lus dang phung por bcas pa yi/ /gnas par dbang ba'i rigs grub phyir/ /lhag rtogs 'byung las lus bcas 'das/ /zag bcas zad pa'i rigs chen te/ /ji ltar bcad kyang bzlog pa min/ /rang dbang thob pa'i dbugs dbyung phyir/ /skabs su bden pa bar ma mthong*/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni rang gi lus gang bsgom pa'i cha byad du dbang gyur pa ste/ zhus lan las/ rang lus rgyal ba'i phyag rgya che/ /bsgom pas mngon du gyur pa'i lha/ /mtshan dang dpe byad mngon shes ldan/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin grags/ /zhes so/ /'o na sangs rgyas dngos su gyur mod snyam na/ da dung sgrib pa mtha' dag dang ma bral bas bsgrub dgos te/ 'di ltar mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa dang*/ /zhes pas/ dang po sangs rgyas thob par bshad kyang*/sa lhag ma'i dri ma sbyang dgos par gsungs pa bzhin du 'dir yang shes par bya ste/ rdo rje las/ byang chub phyag rgya'i cha lugs sku/ / mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs pas/ /cha lugs mngon du gyur na yang*/ /zhi ba de nyid mthong ba min/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni spangs pa dang*/ rtogs pa mthar phyin pas sangs rgyas te/ rdo rje las/ snga ma'i rigs las mthu rdzogs pas/ /bshad pa bzhin du dri ma sbyangs/ /sangs rgyas pa yi shes rab gsum/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin no/ /zhes so/

/gnyis pa rang bzhin bye brag tu bshad pa la bzhi ste/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i skye ba/ zag pa med pa'i bsdus tshul/ pha rol phyin pa'i rdzogs tshul/ mthar thug pa'i rdzogs tshul lo/ /dang po ni rig 'dzin de dag gis 'gro ba'i don du mi'i gtso bo 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ lha'i gtso bo tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa dang*/ tshangs pa chen po'i skye bar sprul nas gang la gang 'dul gyi don byed do/ /kha cig rnam smin gyis mi/ tshe dbang gis lha/ phyag rgya chen pos tshangs pa/ lhun grub kun gyi rol bar bzhed de 'gal ba med do/ gnyis pa la rnam smin tshogs sbyor ba mthar thug gis dang*/ tshe dbang mthong lam man chad slob pa'i sa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po 'phags pa'i ye shes/ mthong sgom gyi rtogs pa khyad par can gyi sa dang*/ lhun grub sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus kyang*/ de thams cad phyogs gcig tu khyad par gyis bsdus te/ der nges par mthong du byed pa ste/ dper na lcags kyus zin pa'i nya chu nang na yod kyang skam sar bton pa dang 'dra'o/ de yang 'phags pa'i ye shes kyi cha nas phyag rgya chen po dang*/ skye shi med pa'i cha nas tshe dbang du btags pa'o/ /gzhan yang sar chud pa/ sa la gnas pa/ sar smin pa ste gsum du'ang bshad de/ kha cig dang po tshe dbang phyag rgya brgyad pa lhun grub bcu par 'dod pa ni sgyu 'phrul gyi dgongs pa ma lon te/ de tshe bcu drug yan chad kyi/ sku lnga lhun gyis rdzogs pa ni/ /zhes pa dang*/ lus ma bor sangs rgyas pa/ /zhes lhun grub sangs rgyas su bshad pa dang 'gal zhing tshe dbang dang phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid ma chad par snang ngo*/ /gsum pa ni rim gyis pas pha rol phyin pa bcu rim gyis sbyangs shing sa bcu 'phar bar ston la/ cig car pas myur du rdzogs pa ste/ de'ang chos thams cad la yongs su 'dzin pa med pa dang sbyin pas pha rol phyin pa 'bras bu dang bcas pa rtsol ba med par lhun grub kyis rdzogs par bstan to/

/de bzhin du mnyam nyid du rigs pas gos pa med pa dang blang dor med pa ni tshul khrims so/ /'khrugs pa med pa dang ye shes kyi mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa ni bzod pa'o/ /nyams pa med pa dang bya spyod tshogs su 'gyur ba ni brtson 'grus/ dbang po yul la 'jug kyang mnyam nyid las mi g.yo zhing chos kyi rang bzhin la gnas pa ni bsam gtan no/ rang bzhin phyin ci ma log pa rtogs pas dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa las 'das pa ni shes rab bo/ /bdag kyang gzhan don du 'gyur ba thabs so/ /zhing dang spyod yul yang dag tu 'gyur ba ni smon lam mo/ /mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis yongs su mi brdzi ba ni stobs so/ /don ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa ni ye shes te/ pha rol tu phyin pa sa bcu lhun gyis rdzogs pas sa bcu pa dang*/ ring mo zhig tu sbyangs mi dgos par myur du rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /yon tan ni sa dang po skad cig snga phyi med bzhin du sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal blta ba la sogs pa brgya phrag bcu gnyis mngon du byed de/ phal po che las/ ting 'dzin brgya dang sangs rgyas brgya rnams mthong byed cing*/ /zhing brgya bskyod cing rab tu snang byed kun tu 'gro/ /sems can brgya skyong chos kyi sgo la 'god par byed/ /bskal pa brgyar 'jug lus brgya rab tu ston par byed/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyang brgya yi grangs tshang rab tu ston/ /de yi gong na smon pastobs ldan tshad kyang med/ /ces so/ /de bzhin du sa gnyis par stong phrag bcu gnyis/ gsum par 'bum phrag bcu gnyis/ bzhi par bye ba brgya phrag bcu gnyis/ lnga par bye ba stong phrag bcu gnyis/ drug par bye ba khrag khrig bcu gnyis/ bdun par khrag khrig 'bum phrag bcu gnyis/ brgyad par stong chen 'bum phrag gcig gi rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa/ dgu par 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul dang mnyam pa/ bcu par brjod du med pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal blta ba dang*/

chos nyan pa dang*/ zhing g.yo bar byed pa dang*/ 'od kyis gsal bar byed pa dang*/ zhing de dag tu 'gro ba dang*/ sems can smin par byed pa dang*/ chos sgo 'byed pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/ dus skad cig ma gcig skal pa du mar ston zhing*/ bskal pa du mar skad cig ma cig ston pa dang*/ sngon du phyi ma'i mtha' de snyed la gzigs pa 'jug pa dang*/ rang gi lus sangs rgyas kyi sku du mar 'phrul pa dang*/ de re re la'ang 'khor du mas bskor bar ston pa rnams skad cig snga phyi med par 'byung ngo*/ /bzhi pa mthar thug pa'i thob tshul ni/ de ltar sa bcu rdzogs nas 'od zer mang po bkye ste sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa dang*/ ye shes kyi snang ba dang*/ thugs rje chen pos chags pa med pa bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma can gyi sa dang*/ chos thams cad dbang mthar thug pa lhun gyis rdzogs pa bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'am/ yi ge 'khor tshogs chen nam/ khyad par chen po'am/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa zhes bya ba lhun gyis rdzogs pa'o/ /de yang sa bcu gsum pa 'di nyid chos sku spros dang bral ba'i cha nas khyad par chen po de'i ngang las longs sku'i 'char gzhi byed pas yi ge 'khor tshogs chen/ de nyid kun gyi bla ma yin pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ ye shes mthar thug gi ngo bo yin pas rig pa 'dzin pa zhes yon tan gyi cha nas de skad du grags so/ /sa 'di dag la skas kyi gdang bu ltar mtho dman yod pa ma y-in te/ sangs rgyas gcig gi ngo bo la sku gsum gyi cha nas de skad ces brjod do/ /yon tan gyis phye ba'i de dang de las mang bar yang gsungs te bde ba tshad med pa bcu bzhi pa bde ba chen po/ bco lnga pa ting nge 'dzin/ bcu drug pa ye shes bla ma zhes grags shing*/ don gyi ngo bo la grub bsal med pa gcig tu'ang bshad/ kun tu bzang po dbye ba med pa rdzogs pa chen po sa gcig pa ste/

kun byed las/ gcig ni kun byed byang chub sems kyi sa/ /zhes so/ 'bras bu bshad zin to// //spyi don gnyis pa skathun mong ma yin pa la } gsum ste rdzogs pa chen po sde gsum gyi rnam grangs bkod pa/ rgyud kyi 'chad thabs bstan pa/ mjug dge ba bsngo pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ 'og ma las 'phags tshul khyad par can gyi gsang chen nyid bshad do/ /dang po ni/ byang chub sems kun byed rgyal po lta ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ kye sems dpa' chen po 'di nyon ciga'akhor gyi ston pa rnams gsum gyis/ /bstan pa gsum ni gol sgrib med/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ nges par thob pa'i theg pa drug /rdzogs pa chen po gol sar bstan/ /zhes pa nas/ rdzogs pa chen po rgyu 'bras gnyis ltar na/ a nu yo gar gol bar bshad/ /ces so/ /'o na ji lta bu zhe na/ kye sems dpa' chen po/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lta spyod ni/ /rgyu 'bras grub dang mi 'dra ste/ /lta spyod byang chub sems 'di ni/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin te/ /zhes dang*/ lta ba sgom med dam tshig bsrung du med/ /sa la sbyang med lam la bgrod du med/ /phrin las rtsol med dbang la bskur du med/ /sgo gsum rtsol med dkyil 'khor bskyed du med/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis med nam mkha' lta bu+u 'o/ /zhes dang*/ gang zag blang dor byed pa des/ /byang chub nam kha' de mi 'grub/ /blang shing dor ba gol sgrib bo/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa khyad par can gyi gsang chen nyid bshad pa la skor gsum ste/ phyi sems sde/ nang klong sde/ gsang ba man ngag gi sde'i skor de la'ang bkod pa chen po las/ 'on kyang rang nyid 'das 'og tu/ /'di ltar rnam par snang bar 'gyur/ yid can rnams la sems kyi sde/ /nam mkha' can la klong gi sde/ /rim rtsol bral la man ngag sde/ zhes so/ /de 'ang phyi nang gi chos rnams don gzhan nam dkyil 'khor la sogs pa mtha' gcig tu zhen pa rnams la gnyis 'dzin rang rgyud pa spang pa'i phyir thams cad rang byung ye shes kyi rol pa ste/

ma dag pa'i snod bcud dang bcas pa sems kyi 'khrul snang dag pa myang 'das kyi snang ba dang rol par bstan pas gnyis med mtha' grol chen por dbyings su sdud pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /gnyis pa rgyud kyi 'chad thabs bstan pa la gnyis te/ ngo bo ngos bzung ba/ 'chad thabs dang gnyis so/ mu tig phreng ba las/ e ma ho rdo rje 'dzin pa nyon/ /de nyid rnam par bshad bya ba/ don gyi rgyud dang sems kyi rgyud/ /ces pa'i don gyi rgyud la'ang thabs rgyud dang*/ rang bzhin gyi rgyud gnyis/ dang po la'ang mtshon bya thabs kyi rgyud dang*/ mtshon byed thabs kyi rgyud do/ /de'ang de nyid las/ gzhi gcig ngo bo'i khyad par las/ mtshon bya dang ni mtshon byed med/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa rang bzhin gyi rgyud ni/ rig pa rang 'od sgron ma dang bcas te/ de nyid las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /rgyud kyi snying po rab tu dbye/ /'khor dang 'das pa gang gis kyang*/ /'di nyid shes pa ma yin te/ /mi 'byed rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ /rang rgyud mtshon pa'i gzhi gcig pa'i/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gcig /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa tshig rgyud 'chad pa ni/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag mang na'ang*/ 'dir gsang chen bla na med pa'i rgyud bcu bdun gyi dgongs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas chings chen po lnga dang yan lag bzhis shes par bya ba ni/ nyi zla kha sbyor las/ lo rgyus don gyis ma bshad na/ /gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /rtsa ba'i don gyis ma bshad na/ /chos rnams rig par mi 'dus pas/ /mtha' yas pa yi skyon du 'gyur/ /yo ga'i don gyis ma bshad na/ /theg pa'i ru shan mi phyed pas/ /che chung rig pa don med 'gyur/ /tshig gi don gyis ma bshad na/ /rgyud rnams rim par gsal ba'i tshig /'brus mi chom pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /dgos chen don gyis ma bshad na/

/ rdzogs chen bya brtsal med pa la/ don med pa yi skyon du 'gyur/ /zhes so/ / yan lag bzhi ni rig pa rang grol las/ khyung chen mkha' lding lta bu'i blos/ / don gyi khog rnams phub ste bshad/ /stag mo 'chongs stangs shes rab blos/ / don gyi sa chen bcad de bshad/ /rus sbal nur 'gros lta bu'i blos/ /yi ge'i 'bru rnams chom par bshad/ /ces pa don gyi khog dbub/ dkyus kyi sa bcad/ tshig gi don bshad/ man ngag gi don bsdu ba dang bzhi'o/ /phun tshogs pa lnga'i chings kyis 'chad dgos te/ de yang thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ thun mong gi gleng gzhi gang rung cig las mi 'byung la/ 'dir rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po gsang chen nges pa'i rgyud rnams thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ thun mong ba gnyis su 'byung ba ni/ chos dbyings don gyi 'og min du/ rang byung gi rig pa'i ston pa 'pho 'gyur ma mchis pa/ chos blang ba dang dor ba med pa'i rang bzhin/ 'khor rang las tha mi dad pa ye shes rol pa'i 'khor te/ nyid la nyid ched du gleng bas 'di skad bdag gis bshad pa'am bstan pa'i dus gcig na zhes 'byung la/ tshig gi rgyud de nyid gang du byung bas nyams su len pa'i skabs su don sdud tha dad 'byung ba la 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na zhes gleng gzhi gnyis su bka' stsal pa yin no/

{de dag cung zad mdor bsdus pas kyang gsang chen sngags la slob pa'i rim pa mdor bstan tsam zhig go nus pa'i dbang du byas nas blo gros dang rtsol pa dman pa 'ga'i don du bstan pa'o/ /} de ltar rgyud don zab cing rgya che'i 'phags blos spyod yul gangs can mtsho/ /mkha' ltar rab zhi rnyog pa kun bral gzod nas 'dus ma byas/ /ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa'i gsang chen shin tu rmad byung mtha' yas gang*/ / rgyal pa'i thugs rjes 'gro la snang bya'i gangs ri'i khrod 'dir cung zad gsal/ /'di lta'i dge ba 'od dkar rnyog med des/ /rab rib rmongs pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa//'od gsal gdod ma'i snang ba mngon gyur nas/ /phyam gcig 'gyur med zhing la spyod par shog /tshul 'di skal bzang slob bu'i mchog gyur pa/ /blo bzang dge ba'i 'byung gnas dam pa dang*/ /dad ldan gtong phod sri zhu'i mchog gyur pa/ /shākya ye shes bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ /ji bzhin don gnyis spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rgyud don zab mo rang bzhin mngon phyung nas/ /gangs ri thod dkar rin chen snying po'i mgul/ /o rgyan rdzong zhes bya ba'i gnas su bkod/ /sngags kyi spyi don tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgra zhes bya ba/ /dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon blo ldan mchog sred kyis rjes su bzung zhing sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho la mang du thos shing legs par sbyangs pa'i me tog rgyun chags pas blo'i pad mtsho gang bar byas pa/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor ba klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ 'brug gi lo dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad bkra shis kyi nyi ma shar ba la legs par bgyis pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (25) sngags kyi spyi don tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgra/ -PAGE 10--PAGE 11--PAGE 1-
